notes.title: Demo Update: More Chips + QoL Additions!
notes.notes:

Discover Chips during your runs and use them to place powerful bets.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Inventory Feature: View Your Current Wheel Anytime[/b] A new tab in the inventory lets you inspect your current wheel configuration from anywhere.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wheel Preview Improvements[/b] You can now preview your wheel in all three bet states both in the Pocket Shop and your inventory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Color Bets and Pocket Bets are now highlighted[/b]

notes.title: Demo Feature Update: Bet Meter & More!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471394/848e155d463dc38db6eeca8cac38e9d1a850e1bf.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]New feature: Bet Meter![/b] Using Chips to bet successfully fills the meter. Once it’s full, you gain a extra chips!
[*] You now start with [b]10 Chips[/b] instead of 5!
[*] Added visual feedback for [b]changing bet state[/b]
[*] Visual improvements to [b]HP & Shields bars[/b]
[*] Minor changes to [b]tutorial[/b]
[*] Full Heal in shop was replaced by [b]50% Heal[/b]
[*] Each shop item can only be bought [b]once per floor[/b]
[*] Shop items are now [b]slightly more expensive[/b]
